user.title: Choose a Local Link route
user.description: Select a route from the published Local Link timetable index. If the index is unavailable, enter the timetable URL manually.

details.title: Choose a stop
details.description: Stops are discovered from the selected timetable where possible. If discovery is unavailable, enter the stop name manually. Select the operating days and optionally narrow the timetable by direction or service column.

error.invalid_url: Use an HTTPS timetable page hosted on locallinklmf.ie.
error.stop_not_found: No timetable row with departure times matched that stop and direction text.
error.ambiguous_stop: The stop or timetable has multiple possible matches. Add a direction/section hint or select a service-column heading to choose the intended timetable.
error.cannot_connect: Could not load the timetable page. Check the URL and try again.
error.service_days: Select at least one day of the week.
error.stop_list_unavailable: Could not discover stop names from this page. You can still type the stop name manually.
error.holiday_calendar_required: Choose a public-holiday calendar when configuring a holiday service column.
error.holiday_service_column_required: Choose the ordinary service column as well as the public-holiday column.
error.holiday_column_required: Choose a public-holiday column when selecting a public-holiday calendar.

abort.already_configured: This timetable page, stop, and direction are already configured.
